subject: Nanotechnology
title: Nano Membranes for Fuel Cells
description: A short lesson to help you apply Nano Membranes for Fuel Cells.

hook.text: Nafion membranes conduct protons but cost 500 dollars per square meter — nano alternatives aim to slash that price.

buildup.text: Proton exchange membranes must conduct H⁺ while blocking gas crossover — a delicate nano-porous balance.

discovery.text: Nano-composite membranes with silica or zeolite fillers retain water at high temperature — boosting conductivity.

twist.text: Filler agglomeration creates gas leak paths — uniform nano-dispersion is critical but hard to achieve.

climax.text: Hydrocarbon nano-membranes now match Nafion performance at a fraction of the cost — scaling for mass market.

punchline.text: A membrane just nanometers thick decides if a fuel cell is affordable.

quiz.question: What is the role of nano-fillers in fuel cell membranes?
options: They retain water and improve proton conductivity at high temperatures
They catalyze the hydrogen oxidation reaction
